name: Ben Cline
page_title: Ben Cline's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Republican for U.S. House (VA) - District 6

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "Despite the clear intention of the Supreme Court in Dobbs, the President insists on placing politics above life and ignoring this decision. I will continue to stand for life and fight this executive order."

"From the moment of conception, all life has great value. We have a duty to protect the weakest among us – the unborn. Over the past 50 years, more than 60 million lives have been lost to abortion. I have always been a champion of pro-life legislation that protects our God-given right to life, and I’ll never stop fighting for the unborn."

"Today marks 47 years since Roe v. Wade was decided by the US Supreme Court. Since 1973, over 50 million preborn children in America have had their lives cut short. The right to life is our most basic human right, and I will continue fighting to protect the most innocent among us."
Rated 100% by National Right to Life Committee

Rated 0% by Alliance for Retired Americans

"Joe Biden says that Republicans want "Medicare and Social Security to sunset." That’s a flat out LIE."

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "Every day, American’s make tough decisions to balance their budgets and so should Congress. I will hold Washington accountable by putting an end to wasteful spending and returning as many tax dollars as possible back to the citizens – after all, it’s your money, not the government’s money!"

"The Biden administration promised that the IRS would not tax or target Americans making less than $400,000, yet a new report shows 63% of new audits targeted taxpayers with income of less than $200K. It’s clear now what those extra 87,000 IRS agents & staff were for…"

"The Tax Reform package of 2017 was a step in the right direction, but more work is needed. Ben supports further simplifying the tax code and reducing rates and the number of tax brackets, which will allow more hard-working residents of the Sixth District to keep more of what they earn. Taxation should be used for raising federal revenues to fund the core functions of government found in the Constitution, not used as a tool to enact economic and social engineering. Ben has fought for lower taxes in Richmond and will do the same thing in Washington."
Rated 94% by The Club for Growth

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "During a @JudiciaryGOP field hearing on violent crime, I heard firsthand how Chicago politicians’ push to defund the police has only demoralized law enforcement & hurt their ability to do their job. This has created a dangerous community for Chicago residents & they’re fed up."

"I firmly support law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line to keep us safe. As a former prosecutor, I’ve seen firsthand the immense good these men and women provide for our families and communities. By opposing the foolish and reckless proposals to defund the police, we can ensure there will always be law enforcement who are ready and willing to run towards the sounds of danger."
